versions.changelog:
Initial release.

- Enables Douyin (TikTok China) public data collection via 4 commands for video/user search, creator posts, video comments, and real-time hot trends.
- Supports all common link formats (PC, mobile short link, or direct ID).
- Outputs results as structured JSON, logging each query automatically.
- Provides standardized error handling, parameter inference, and security-compliant token management.
- Includes full documentation of command options, parameter mapping, and usage examples.
- Limits access to public data only; does not support publishing, editing, downloading, or private info.
